alarm_definition.exact_excerpt:
INTEGER, PARAMETER :: COMPUTE_VORTEX_CENTER_ALARM = 2*(25)+5

  INTEGER, PARAMETER :: MAX_WRF_ALARMS    = COMPUTE_VORTEX_CENTER_ALARM

alarm_disable.exact_excerpt:
CALL WRFU_AlarmDisable( grid%alarms( COMPUTE_VORTEX_CENTER_ALARM ), rc=rc )
   CALL wrf_check_error( WRFU_SUCCESS, rc, &
                         'WRFU_AlarmDisable(COMPUTE_VORTEX_CENTER_ALARM) FAILED', &
                         "set_timekeeping.G" , &

physics_init.exact_excerpt:
IF (config_flags%mp_physics == UDMSCHEME .AND. &
       config_flags%ra_lw_physics == RRTMGP_LWSCHEME .AND. &
       config_flags%ra_sw_physics == RRTMGP_SWSCHEME) THEN
      IF (PRESENT(udm_cldfra)) THEN
         IF (ASSOCIATED(udm_cldfra)) udm_cldfra = -1.
      ENDIF
      IF (PRESENT(udm_cf_step)) THEN
         IF (ASSOCIATED(udm_cf_step)) udm_cf_step = -1
      ENDIF
      IF (PRESENT(udm_cf_top)) THEN
         IF (ASSOCIATED(udm_cf_top)) udm_cf_top = -1
      ENDIF
   ENDIF

registry.exact_excerpt:
state real udm_cldfra ikj misc 1 - h "UDM_CLDFRA" "Last cloud fraction used by UDM microphysics" "fraction"
state integer udm_cf_step ij misc 1 - h "UDM_CF_STEP" "Timestep of last UDM cloud-fraction diagnostic" "step"
state integer udm_cf_top ij misc 1 - h "UDM_CF_TOP" "Native layer extent of last UDM cloud-fraction diagnostic" "layer"
